CHAPTER 2 · ITEM 10 / 12

Production possibilities frontier (PPF)

Peace dividend on a bowed PPF彎曲 PPF 的轉產收益

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Compare the gains in one good from giving up a given quantity of another at different locations on a bowed frontier.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

向外彎曲邊界上，已大量生產橫軸商品時，其邊際機會成本較高。因此在不同起點放棄同量該商品，可換回不同數量另一商品。

On a bowed PPF, the opportunity cost of the horizontal good is greater where much of it is already produced. Giving up the same amount of that good can therefore release different quantities of the other good at different locations.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：With guns on X, shifting 1 unit away from guns near the high-guns end releases more butter than near the low-guns end. 在高軍備端減少一單位軍備可增加較多奶油。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Same small cut in guns on a bowed PPF: where is the butter gain generally larger? 同量減軍備，哪處奶油收益較大？
